_comment: The pinned Oxlint for the class A oxlint:<package> scans (rightkit#1402; PINNED_SCAN_TOOLS in packages/release/deterministic-scans.mjs holds the same version). A host enrols the unpacked binary through scan-tool-enrolment (tool oxlint, its absolute path, the file's sha256 and this version); a class A run on a host where it is not enrolled fails TOOL_UNTRUSTED, never skips. Digests are the archives' sha256 as GitHub's release API reports them for https://github.com/oxc-project/oxc/releases/tag/oxlint_v1.89.0.
